title: Surface weather at Dakshin Gangotri and Maitri, Antarctica, 1985-2010
authors: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)
license: NCPOR/NPDC data policy: free and open access, with acknowledgement of NCPOR as the data owner
description: Surface meteorological observations from India's Antarctic stations Dakshin Gangotri (1985-1989) and Maitri (1990-2010), published by NCPOR's National Polar Data Center. Observations every three hours of air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, wind direction and, for 1985 only, relative humidity. Missing values are recorded as -999. Converted from NCPOR's online data table to CSV without changing any value. The online table lists every observation twice, so the exact duplicates were removed, and the misspelt 'Temperature' column heading was corrected.
